gaps.summary: Production AgentEventReplayPort and app.state.agent_workspace_service composition are not yet proven in a deployed runtime.
gaps.completion_evidence: Tenant-scoped persistent event replay survives API restart/multi-instance routing, honors Last-Event-ID, and powers the NODE-54 SSE endpoint without an in-memory fallback.

gaps.summary: The durable Project Core AgentRun creation path must be proven to start/bind the NODE-28 LangGraph control plane using server-resolved brief, graph/code identity and budget policy.
gaps.completion_evidence: One integration test creates an AgentRun through the public Project API, observes the same run id/thread in NODE-28 control, completes or interrupts the graph, and never requires client-supplied graph/code identity.

gaps.summary: Real browser/MockAgent E2E for start, stream reconnect, exact artifact, stale approval and cancellation has not yet executed successfully.
gaps.completion_evidence: Browser E2E exercises the canonical public API and proves reconnect/dedupe/approval/cancel behavior.

gaps.summary: Hosted GitHub runner execution evidence is required. Prior NODE workflows have repeatedly failed before checkout with zero steps.
gaps.completion_evidence: NODE-54 workflow jobs materialize and execute static/API/web tests, TypeScript typecheck and production build.

gaps.summary: Project Core AgentRun has no durable public conversation transcript or project active/recent-run discovery contract, so NODE-54 does not fabricate cross-refresh chat history or auto-select a prior run.
gaps.completion_evidence: Versioned Conversation/Message API and active/recent run discovery are defined, tenant-scoped, and integrated.

gaps.summary: NODE-55 has not yet supplied actual editable canvas selection/change events. NODE-54 only defines the exact selected_node_ids + design_document_version handoff.
gaps.completion_evidence: NODE-55 selection events populate composer context and selected-only agent edits are verified against the exact document version.

gaps.summary: Only the NODE-28-proven approve action is public. Reject, Request Changes, richer cost/impact payloads and approval audit UX require the later Approval Engine contract.
gaps.completion_evidence: NODE-62 public approval decision schema is integrated with stale fencing and audited reject/request-changes behavior.

gaps.summary: Budget/provider/rights/constraint warning semantics depend on the production safe-event projector conventions and need integration coverage.
gaps.completion_evidence: Fixture/projector tests demonstrate each warning class reaches NODE-54 as a safe structured public event without leaking private payload fields.
